summary: Slang.ai, founded in 2019 by two former Spotify data scientists, is a voice-AI phone-answering platform built for full-service restaurants and multi-location hospitality groups; it answers every inbound call 24/7, books/modifies reservations, answers FAQs, and routes VIP or sensitive calls to staff, but texts a link to online ordering rather than taking orders itself over the phone. (Scope note: Vendor's own comparison page framing of its scope versus a phone-ordering competitor (Revmo); treat the 'not a phone-ordering tool' distinction as Slang's own positioning.)

Slang AI raised a $36 million Series B in February 2026 led by US Venture Partners (USVP), bringing total funding to $68 million; the company reports its AI is trained on 25 million customer calls and runs in 2,000+ restaurant locations.
